thread:
jordan: Heads up — found a parity bug between REST and both Node/Python SDKs when client sends an empty embeddings batch. REST returns 200 + [] but SDKs throw a 400 and content gets lost. Repro below. :eyes:
sara: Ugh, thanks. Is this the sample app flow or raw SDK call?
jordan: Raw call to embeddings.batch. Python snippet:```python
res = client.embeddings.batch(model="redwood-embed-large", input=[])
print(res)
```
Response from python SDK: 400 Bad Request, message: "input must not be empty".
REST curl I tried:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large","input":[]}'
```
REST response: 200 OK, body: {"data":[]}
vikram: That's bad — sample-apps that batch user events sometimes send empty batches as a flush signal. SDKs should preserve REST semantics.
emily: Could be validation added in SDKs to avoid sending invalid requests upstream, but it changes semantic equivalence. We need to know intent: do we want to keep REST behavior (noop ok) or enforce non-empty?
jordan: IMO keep REST behavior. Apps expect idempotent flush with empty => no-op. Changing would break client libs.
sara: Agreed. Also noticed Node SDK has different retry behavior for 429s on embeddings: REST client gets a Retry-After respected, Node SDK ignores Retry-After header and uses fixed backoff. Caused spike during Dedicated maintenance.
emily: Can you paste logs?
sara: Snippet from node logs:```json
{"level":"warn","msg":"retrying request","status":429,"wait_ms":1000}
```
But the 429 had Retry-After: 15.
jordan: Repro: REST: 429 -> header Retry-After:15 -> client waits ~15s. Node SDK: retries after 1s, 2s, 4s. Ended up creating extra load.
vikram: Sounds like two issues: param validation parity (empty arrays) and retry header handling. Both are likely in SDK middlewares.
emily: Filing an action item. @sara can you open a GH issue for Node and Python SDKs with stack traces and the sample-app reproduction? Label: sdk-parity, severity: medium->high. I'll also add an e2e test in CI that sends empty batch to embeddings and asserts SDK returns same shape as REST.
sara: Yup. Creating issue now. Also adding sample-app regression test that simulates flush.
jordan: One more oddity: Python SDK's `embeddings.batch` returns an object with `data: []` but missing `usage` field when empty; REST includes usage: {"tokens":0}. Small but breaks some analytics code.
emily: Ack. Add to the issue: ensure response fields consistent (data array, usage object, status code).
vikram: For retries, let's standardize: prefer honoring Retry-After header if present, else exponential backoff with jitter. Make sure Dedicated telemetry shows the difference.
sara: PR link (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/999 (adds Retry-After handling + e2e).
jordan: Nice. Thanks. Also adding a note to onboarding docs: "SDKs mirror REST semantics (including no-op empty batches)" so customers know behavior.
emily: Great. If someone has a minute, let's prioritize the Node retry fix for this week's patch release. :thumbsup:
qa-bot: New issue created: #4567 - sdk-parity: embeddings empty-batch & Retry-After drift. Assigned to @sara, @vikram.
jordan: Thanks — will test PRs once ready. "
